user.title: Reolink account
user.description: Sign in to discover your battery cameras. This does not contact or wake the camera.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.description: Enter the verification code sent by Reolink.

device.title: Select a camera
device.description: Select the battery camera to add.

local.title: Camera-local credentials
local.description: Enter the camera's own admin credentials. Validation opens one short Baichuan session and disconnects immediately; it does not start preview, RTSP, ONVIF, HTTP, or snapshots.

error.invalid_auth: The Reolink account credentials or MFA code were rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Reolink cloud.
error.cannot_connect_device: Could not resolve, wake, or connect to the camera on the selected LAN.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for the failure type.

abort.no_devices: No supported bound Reolink devices were found.
abort.no_lan_interface: No suitable private IPv4 LAN interface is enabled in Home Assistant.
abort.unsupported_auth_path: This milestone supports the verified legacy local-credential path only.
